title: GMAT Focus Data Insights Practice Test 13
instructions: Original exam-style practice test with answers and explanations.

questions.prompt: A graph showing training completion rates in the employee performance sector presents the following data: Sales: 91%, Operations: 73%, HR: 88%, Finance: 95%, IT: 82%. According to the graph, which segment/period shows the highest value?
options: A. Cannot be determined from the data
E. The value closest to the overall average
questions.explanation: This graphics_interpretation question tests ability to interpret employee performance data on training completion rates.

questions.prompt: Based on the chart of property price indices data (City centre: 148, Suburbs: 112, Rural: 89, Coastal: 167), which TWO values would combine to equal approximately the average?
questions.explanation: This graphics_interpretation question tests ability to interpret real estate data on property price indices.

questions.prompt: A scatter plot comparing clinical trial outcomes across pharmaceutical categories shows: Complete response: 34%, Partial response: 28%, Stable disease: 21%, Progression: 17%. If the trend continued, which projection is most consistent?
options: B. The value closest to the overall average
C. Cannot be determined from the data
questions.explanation: This graphics_interpretation question tests ability to interpret pharmaceutical data on clinical trial outcomes.

dataContext.data: Complete response: 34%, Partial response: 28%, Stable disease: 21%, Progression: 17%

questions.prompt: Analysis of customer satisfaction scores in food service: Food quality: 4.2/5, Service speed: 3.8/5, Value: 3.9/5, Ambiance: 4.1/5. Select the value closest to the median AND the value that represents the greatest deviation from the mean.
questions.explanation: This two_part_analysis question tests ability to interpret food service data on customer satisfaction scores.

dataContext.data: Food quality: 4.2/5, Service speed: 3.8/5, Value: 3.9/5, Ambiance: 4.1/5

questions.prompt: Given manufacturing defect rates by production line data: Line A: 0.8%, Line B: 1.4%, Line C: 0.5%, Line D: 2.1%. In the left column select the highest-performing category; in the right column select the category that improved most year-over-year.
questions.explanation: This two_part_analysis question tests ability to interpret manufacturing data on defect rates by production line.

dataContext.data: Line A: 0.8%, Line B: 1.4%, Line C: 0.5%, Line D: 2.1%

questions.prompt: A banking manager reviews loan approval rates: Personal: 64%, Mortgage: 71%, Business: 48%, Auto: 79%, Student: 85%. Select: (1) the category requiring immediate attention and (2) the category that exceeds the target of the average by the greatest margin.
questions.explanation: This two_part_analysis question tests ability to interpret banking data on loan approval rates.

questions.prompt: Analysis of campaign conversion rates in marketing: Email: 3.2%, Social: 1.8%, Search: 4.7%, Display: 0.9%, Referral: 6.1%. Select the value closest to the median AND the value that represents the greatest deviation from the mean.
questions.explanation: This two_part_analysis question tests ability to interpret marketing data on campaign conversion rates.

questions.prompt: Three data sources on telecommunications subscriber churn rates are provided: (Memo) Overall performance improved this quarter. (Table) Postpaid: 2.1%, Prepaid: 8.4%, Broadband: 1.7%, Enterprise: 0.8%. (Email) Stakeholders express concern about outliers. Which source most directly supports the memo's claim?
options: D. All three sources are equally relevant
questions.explanation: This multi_source_reasoning question tests ability to interpret telecommunications data on subscriber churn rates.

questions.prompt: Source 1 (Report): education student assessment pass rates shows: Mathematics: 73%, Science: 68%, English: 81%, History: 77%, Languages: 62%. Source 2 (Email): The weakest performer needs a 20% improvement to meet targets. Source 3 (Table): Targets are set at the top-quartile value. Which category needs improvement?
options: E. All three sources are equally relevant
questions.explanation: This multi_source_reasoning question tests ability to interpret education data on student assessment pass rates.

questions.prompt: Reviewing insurance records: Source A shows claims processing times: Auto: 8.2 days, Home: 14.5 days, Health: 6.1 days, Life: 21.3 days. Source B notes the average. Source C flags values more than 25% above or below average. Which values would Source C flag?
options: A. All three sources are equally relevant
questions.explanation: This multi_source_reasoning question tests ability to interpret insurance data on claims processing times.

dataContext.data: Auto: 8.2 days, Home: 14.5 days, Health: 6.1 days, Life: 21.3 days

questions.prompt: Three data sources on construction project completion on schedule are provided: (Memo) Overall performance improved this quarter. (Table) Residential: 58%, Commercial: 44%, Infrastructure: 37%, Industrial: 51%. (Email) Stakeholders express concern about outliers. Which source most directly supports the memo's claim?
options: B. All three sources are equally relevant
questions.explanation: This multi_source_reasoning question tests ability to interpret construction data on project completion on schedule.

questions.prompt: What is the relative ranking of categories in agriculture crop yield indices? (1) Wheat: 108. (2) The remaining values follow a consistent trend.
options: A. Both statements together are sufficient, but neither alone is sufficient
B. Each statement alone is sufficient
C. Neither statement alone nor together is sufficient
D. Statement (1) alone is sufficient, but statement (2) alone is not sufficient
E. Statement (2) alone is sufficient, but statement (1) alone is not sufficient
questions.explanation: This data_sufficiency question tests ability to interpret agriculture data on crop yield indices.

questions.prompt: Is the e-commerce return rates by product category above the industry benchmark of the median? (1) Electronics: 12%. (2) The range of all values is 15%.
options: A. Statement (2) alone is sufficient, but statement (1) alone is not sufficient
B. Both statements together are sufficient, but neither alone is sufficient
C. Each statement alone is sufficient
D. Neither statement alone nor together is sufficient
E. Statement (1) alone is sufficient, but statement (2) alone is not sufficient
questions.explanation: This data_sufficiency question tests ability to interpret e-commerce data on return rates by product category.

dataContext.data: Electronics: 12%, Clothing: 28%, Home goods: 8%, Books: 3%, Sports: 15%
